outcomeBoundary: The exact PBIP opened from the short immutable snapshot and all fourteen page tabs were safely discoverable through job-owned UI Automation. No PBIX was produced and no native interaction scenario is claimed as passed.
resolvedBlockers: The launch snapshot maximum projected path was 171 characters, below Desktop's legacy limits.
The exact report window and mirrored WebView controls were bound to the owned process job.
Desktop 2.157 File, Save as, and Browse this device controls were invoked through bounded SelectionItemPattern or InvokePattern controls.

blocker.message: Desktop 2.157 exposes its embedded common-file filename control (automation ID 1001) and Save control (automation ID 1) as native Pane elements with no supported UI Automation patterns. The related File name label exposes only a read-only ValuePattern. The harness therefore cannot set the deterministic PBIX path or invoke Save using the required control-bound ValuePattern and InvokePattern guards.

unproven: offline PBIX reopen and byte stability
